# M2E Ltd (M2E Control Systems)

> Independent engineering company in Tamworth, Staffordshire, UK (company no. 09778670, incorporated 2015).
> Control system design, electrical schematics (EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical), in-house functional safety
> (Sistema calculations to performance levels), control panels built and tested in-house, installation
> documentation and supervision.
